trayShell.closeBody:
Closing the window just puts Mclash in the tray — the kernel and system proxy keep working, and your network stays connected.

· OK: minimize to the tray (to quit completely, right-click the tray icon → Quit)
· Cancel: quit Mclash completely, stop the kernel and restore the system proxy

(Your choice is remembered; next time you can use the tray icon directly)
